name: EDGE Energy
old_description: Since 1992, ENERGY STAR and its partners have helped American families and businesses save 5 trillion kilowatt-hours of electricity and avoid more than $500 billion in energy costs.
about:
EDGE Energy is based in Beltsville, Maryland, and was founded in 2006 by Jason Dispenza, who serves as CEO. The company began as a mission-driven contractor focused on helping homeowners across Maryland, Washington, D.C., and Virginia reduce energy consumption and transition to renewable sources.

The firm provides a full suite of home energy services under one roof, including rooftop and ground-mount solar photovoltaic design and installation, solar system cleaning, monitoring, and repair, high-efficiency HVAC and heat pump installation, heat pump water heaters, insulation, air sealing, home energy audits, battery storage, roofing, and net-zero retrofits. All design, installation, and service work is performed by EDGE's own employees rather than subcontractors. Since 2006, the company has completed more than 5,000 projects and operates with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

EDGE Energy primarily serves residential customers in the DMV region, addressing needs ranging from solar power and electrification to weatherization and HVAC upgrades. The company also handles warranty and out-of-warranty service for all major solar brands and offers full removal and reinstallation of systems for roof replacements or structural work.

The company emphasizes its in-house expertise and accountability after installation as key differentiators, citing its six-time recognition as an ENERGY STAR® Contractor of the Year by the U.S. EPA as evidence of its compliant, reliable approach.

about:
EDL Packaging, a Massman Company, is based in De Pere, Wisconsin. The business draws on over six decades of experience in the shrink wrapping and multi-packing industry, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. It operates as part of the Massman Companies group, which bundles several packaging machinery brands under common ownership.

The company designs and builds flexible secondary packaging equipment for bundling consumer and industrial products in low-density polyethylene (LDPE) film. Its core product line includes shrink wrappers, shrink bundlers, roll wrappers, automatic flight bar wrappers, forming shoe wrappers, tray formers, and loaders. Both standard and custom-engineered machines are offered, with specific models such as the SV342 wrap-around tray former, SV346 twin-stream flight bar wrapper, and SV348 double tight wrap servo system.

EDL serves a range of industries including pet food, building materials, food, beverage, personal care, carpet and underlayment, grain, and medical/pharmaceutical. Customers are typically manufacturers of consumer and industrial products seeking end-of-line packaging solutions. The broader Massman portfolio adds unscramblers, liquid fillers, pouch fillers, cappers, lidders, cartoners, case packers, and palletizers through partner divisions such as Massman Automation, Ideal Pase, DTM Packaging, New England Machinery, and ADCO Manufacturing.

EDL emphasizes safe, efficient, high-quality machinery design and aims to deliver the most reliable equipment in its field. The company highlights comprehensive turn-key system engineering, quick installation, smooth startup, and the convenience of a single agreement for all machines on a production line through the Massman Companies network.

old_description: Celebrating 40 years of leadership in pressure injury prevention and safe patient handling, we are proud to continue our mission of protecting both patients, staff, and healthcare teams. With a strong legacy of partnership and dedication, our solutions have set the standard in the industry, making safety our top priority. about:
EHOB, Inc. is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, and has been supporting better outcomes for patients and clinicians since its founding in 1985. The company began by collaborating closely with healthcare partners to understand real-world challenges in pressure injury prevention and safe patient handling, a dialogue that continues to guide its design and development process.

The company manufactures a range of pressure injury prevention and patient positioning solutions, including heel offloading devices, moisture management products, and patient positioning systems. These solutions are developed through direct engagement with clinical partners to address the realities healthcare teams face daily, from preventing pressure injuries to reducing staff injuries from repetitive tasks.

EHOB serves healthcare facilities across the United States, including hospitals and long-term care settings. Its products have been trialed in hundreds of facilities nationwide between 2021 and 2025, and the company provides clinical support, evidence-based protocols, and expert consultation to assist healthcare professionals with implementation.

EHOB was built on the principle that healthcare professionals need more than products to keep patients safe.

name: ELECTRO CIRCUITS
old_description: When the demands of your business or conscience demand “Made in U.S.A.” Electro Circuits is there.
about:
Electro Circuits is a printed circuit board manufacturer based in Stafford, Texas. The company was founded in 2005 and has accumulated over two decades of experience in PCB design, fabrication, and assembly.

The shop produces single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer boards up to 20 layers and beyond, working with materials such as polyamide, Teflon, Rogers, and flex/rigid-flex constructions. It offers PCB design, fabrication, and turnkey assembly services, including quick-turn prototypes and high-volume production runs. Finishes include ENIG, ENEPIG, silver, and carbon, all compliant with RoHS requirements. Every board undergoes electrical testing before shipment.

Electro Circuits serves customers in sectors that require ITAR registration and military specifications, such as defense and aerospace. Long-term clients include REI and PMQ Alternatives, Inc., both of which have relied on the company for more than 20 years for PCB design, manufacturing, and assembly.

The company emphasizes domestic production—"Made in U.S.A."—and promotes fast turnaround times with minimal customer interaction. A customer testimonial notes that orders are placed and forgotten, with boards arriving on time without technical holds or handholding. Competitive pricing is offered for both domestic and international manufacturing options.

name: EMS, Inc (Electronic Manufacturing Solutions)
old_description: With over 19 years of experience in delivering superior products.
about:
EMS, Inc. operates a 20,000-square-foot facility in Lincoln, Arkansas. The company was founded in 2007 and has grown into a full-service electronics contract manufacturer serving OEMs across the United States.

The company provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing under one roof, including PCB design and layout, surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly (with BGA and QFN capability), cable and wire harness assembly, electro-mechanical box build, test fixture design, design-for-manufacturing analysis, component procurement, and rework/repair. It handles prototype through high-volume production runs.

EMS serves industries such as oil and gas, transportation and logistics, IoT, agriculture, fitness, HVAC, automotive, trucking, medical, aviation, food packaging, telecommunications, emergency services, energy, product marking, industrial motor manufacturing, automation, and railroad. Recent projects include a cavity-mounted sensor for transportation, a motor control board and downhole monitoring system for oil and gas, a motor assembly for industrial automation, and a cardio equipment console for fitness.

The company emphasizes a single-location model that reduces handoffs, offering clear quotes, on-time delivery, and direct access to the engineers building each product. It also specializes in labor-intensive "dirty jobs" that can slow customer production lines, aiming to provide a shorter, more reliable supply chain.

about:
EPEC Solutions, Inc. was founded in 2016 in Clayton, North Carolina, on Christian principles of prayer and servant leadership. The company's stated purpose is to glorify God by developing employees' skills and serving customers as good stewards while supporting communities through service and ministry funding.

The company manufactures electrical switchboards and power distribution equipment at four facilities across North America. Its product line includes modular UL 891 switchboards rated 208–800 VAC and 1,200–6,000 A, low‑voltage UL 891 switchboards (480/600/800 VAC, 400–4,000 A) with an optional 55 % domestic content, a 660–800 VAC BoS family featuring an industry‑first 800 V main breaker, unit substation skidded solutions, and 1,200–6,000 A 800 VDC switchboards for AI data centers. Additional offerings cover AC recombiners, rack‑on‑rails systems, remote power panels, PDUs, grounding transformers, integrated solar skids, and EV charging switchboards.

EPEC serves the data center, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and EV charging sectors, primarily in the United States and Canada. Customers include renewable power plant developers and data center operators who collaborate directly with EPEC's engineering and project management teams for tailored designs.

The company differentiates itself through pre‑fabricated factory solutions that reduce installation risk and speed deployment, compact modular designs packing up to 30 feeders in a 90″×60″×36″ footprint, electronic‑trip MCCBs to eliminate nuisance tripping, and 100 % rated breakers that allow smaller cable sizing. Its mission‑driven culture emphasizes servant leadership and community advocacy.

name: East Jordan Plastics
old_description: It all started four generations ago when Ken and Shirley Diller founded East Jordan Box and Crate Co. to produce wooden greenhouse flats for bedding plant growers in the Midwest. From those wooden flats to today’s comprehensive line of sustainable plastic plant containers, East Jordan Plastics remains committed to the only industry it has ever served—horticulture.
about:
East Jordan Plastics operates from East Jordan, Michigan, where Ken and Shirley Diller founded East Jordan Box and Crate Co. four generations ago to produce wooden greenhouse flats for Midwestern bedding-plant growers. The business remains family-owned and has served the horticulture industry exclusively for nearly 80 years, evolving from wooden flats to a full line of sustainable plastic plant containers.

The company injection-molds a comprehensive range of horticultural containers — SHUTTLE™ hanging baskets, planters and bowls; the patented SHUTTLE POT® STADIUM® pots and trays with squared-off sides for space-saving shipping; SHUTTLE POT® and SHUTTLE TRAY® lines built for quick de-nesting on automated lines; plus trays, carriers, flats, inserts, and precision-engineered plug and propagation trays. A closed-loop recycling program, certified for Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) content by AM Testing, feeds reclaimed material back into production. All products are made in the USA.

Customers are greenhouse and nursery growers, from large automated operations to smaller propagators. Bradford Greenhouses and Linwell Gardens are cited as users; the STADIUM line is noted to deliver 12–14% more growing space per bench. Trays and carriers are designed for automated destacking, filling, transplanting and transport equipment, while plug trays support both hand-sticking and high-volume seed sowing.

The company says its differentiation comes from a single-industry focus, a closed-loop sustainability model that recycles used containers into new ones, and product designs — such as the STADIUM® line’s flat sides for labeling and offset printing — that address growers’ handling, shipping and marketing needs.
